method: percentile of (in-sync: timing, accounts vs the article's normal pace) x (unusual accounts: dormancy, new, shared removals elsewhere) among all groups of 2+ accounts removing text from the same article within 12 hours; bots and reverts excluded

planted_example.label: PLANTED TEST RING - not real editors

evidence.label: Accounts
evidence.explain: Distinct accounts that removed text from this article within 12 hours of each other.

evidence.label: Timing
evidence.explain: Time between the first and last removal in the group. Ordinary editing is spread out.

evidence.label: Activity
evidence.explain: How many accounts usually removed text from this article per day that month. A group on a busy article is less unusual than the same group on a quiet one.

evidence.label: Dormancy
evidence.explain: Accounts that had made no edit in these articles for a year or more beforehand.

evidence.label: New
evidence.explain: Accounts whose first edit in these articles came less than a month earlier.

evidence.label: Overlap
evidence.explain: Accounts that also removed text from the same other articles within a week.

evidence.label: Baseline
evidence.explain: How in sync they were, times how unusual the accounts were, compared with every group of accounts that removed text together in the 19,742 articles. Zero when the accounts look ordinary, however close the timing.
